title: BBLog: Display BBLog information for IN/OUT events

notes.body:
Why is all the BBLog code added to the frame dissector?
Doesn't this belong in packet-bblog.c or another separate file?

When using BBLog, you have some events (like starting a timer, stopping a timer, for example), which are not related to TCP segments and events which correspond to sending or receiving a TCP segment.
In the first case (which are most events), all the information in handled in the `packet-bblog.c`. In the case of in/out events (only these two), this is handled in the frame dissector and then the ip/tcp dissector handles the packet, which was sent or received.
If you have a better way to deal with this, I'm open for discussion.
If you want, I can share a capture file.
I have no knowledge about BBLog, I just found it a bit strange to have a lot of BBLog handling in `packet-frame.c`. If you have a capture file I can of course have a look.

I think `packet-frame.c` handles also other meta information.
Here is an example file: [UNKNOWN_8080_192.0.2.1_61541.0.pcapng](/uploads/9b6b667e6c673074a8d91a0bffa6a940/UNKNOWN_8080_192.0.2.1_61541.0.pcapng).
Please let me know if you have ideas for better Wireshark integration. Please note that only IN/OUT events are handled in `packet-frame.c`, since the BBLog information is additional to the IP packet. All other events are handled by the `packet-bblog.c`.
I will have a look. I have started to add support for Custom Block in `file-pcapng.c` in !10480.

Interesting. How can I use it? I guess it would have been helpful when I added support for the BBLog specific blocks and options a while ago in https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/commit/b17f354304242ac14769f7b4f13b65b077b769a8. Only relied on debug output.

It's just the very first step, but it does show PEN and the custom data block. Select "View -> Reload as File Format/Capture" to show the pcapng content.

I see that both packet-frame.c and packet-bblog.c show the same values (ticks, serial_number, event_id, etc.), and this should be dissected in one place and have the same field names for filtering and searching.

I'm thinking about adding a register function for dissectors to handle Custom Block and Custom Options, just like `dissector_add_uint()` etc.

I did not know about `Reload as File Format/Capture`, great feature. Thanks for improving it for `.pcapng`.
I agree, that it would be great to have a unified way of handling the information. Right now, Wireshark does not have the infrastructure to do so, I think. Let me know if you have any questions or need help. I'm willing to improve the situation.
